card.name: Start of capitalized words like PEDIATRIC
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a word that is split apart, mostly a lone capital P starting PEDIATRIC, PREGNANT or PTH in all-caps label text. It also fires on a few other word starts such as St in Stomach.

modes.label: All-caps P starts
modes.description: A lone capital P begins a word like PEDIATRIC or PREGNANT in uppercase label headings.

modes.label: Other split word starts
modes.description: A word is broken into pieces, such as St in Stomach or the end of CREATININE.

card.writes: It pushes toward angle-bracket symbols like > and <, and away from unrelated Chinese and place-name tokens.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letter of a word that has been chopped up, especially the P in all-capital PEDIATRIC or PREGNANT.
